lanes.label: x402-style HTTP payment adapter
lanes.fit: API and agent payments can map a 402 payment request to a TN12 invoice, accepted transfer, receipt, and retry token.
lanes.next: Build a local HTTP 402 demo endpoint that returns payment requirements, accepts a TN12 txid proof, verifies it through the reducer, and releases a mock resource.

lanes.label: ISO 20022-style payment metadata
lanes.fit: Payment initiation/remittance fields can be represented as payload receipt metadata and reconciled against accepted transfers.
lanes.next: Create a pacs/pain-inspired JSON mapping for payer, payee, amount, remittance reference, accepted txid, and reconciliation status.

lanes.label: Digital Token Identifier style asset map
lanes.fit: Asset receipts, access passes, and future native assets need stable identifiers that are separate from marketing tickers.
lanes.next: Add an asset-id registry artifact with issuer, symbol, network, asset class, receipt txid, and no-claim status.

lanes.label: Native asset / access pass rail
lanes.standard: Kaspa Toccata asset rules and ecosystem pass workflows
lanes.fit: Access passes, coupons, tickets, and closed-loop credits can use accepted receipts now and covenant/native-asset rules later.
lanes.next: Bind one pass issuance, transfer, and redemption flow to accepted receipts and an issuer review artifact.

lanes.label: Attestation and oracle envelope
lanes.fit: External facts should enter as explicit source, reporter, timestamp, dispute, and confidence records before any market or insurance action uses them.
lanes.next: Create one generic event-attestation envelope and negative cases for stale, conflicting, missing-quorum, and unauthenticated inputs.

lanes.label: Agent task settlement receipts
lanes.fit: Agents need small agreements: task description, payment, completion proof, dispute state, and release/refund status.
lanes.next: Turn the existing agent invoice/escrow receipts into a minimal agent task API with accepted txid replay.

lanes.label: Wallet signing and human intent review
lanes.fit: Institutional or public use requires human-readable signing intents and returned signed bytes that validate before submit.
lanes.next: Keep request templates and validators ready; only promote after a real external wallet signs, submit succeeds, and replay matches.

rules: Use standards as adapters and message shapes, not as claims of certification or institutional adoption.
Every adapter needs a source message, a TN12 txid or receipt, a reducer rule, and a negative case.
Do not claim ISO compliance, x402 compatibility, DTI registration, or production custody until a working integration proves that exact claim.
